biggest_catch: Getting your first tasks takes time — you need a background check, an approved profile, and reviews before clients pick you, and clients are charged only after your invoice goes in.
catches: Taskers must pass a background check and register before working; onboarding takes days.
You set your own rates but compete with other Taskers on price, reviews, and responsiveness.
Payment requires invoicing after the task; the client is charged within 24 hours of your invoice, then Stripe processing adds 1–3 business days.
Taskers are independent contractors — no guaranteed work, no benefits; all payments must go through the platform (off-platform payment is banned).

c1.evidence: Official TaskRabbit blog (taskrabbit.com, updated July 2026): 'Being a Tasker is a flexible and consistent way to earn... Work as little or as much as you like.' Official support.taskrabbit.com documents Tasker onboarding and invoicing.

c2.evidence: Official taskrabbit.com blog: 'Get Paid Fast: Most payouts arrive within 1–3 business days. Tips too!' Taskers set their own hourly/fixed rates; invoice = hours worked + agreed expenses; Taskers keep 100% of expenses and tips. Amounts are tasker-set per task (no fixed official range).

c3.evidence: No fee to join stated on official pages reviewed; earnings paid via direct deposit.

c4.evidence: Official taskrabbit.com blog FAQ: 'How often do I get paid? Taskrabbit processes payments through Stripe. Most arrive within 1–3 business days after task completion.' Support: 'Taskers can receive payouts when transactions have finished processing (usually around 2 to 4 business days).'

eligibility: 18+; ID + SSN; background check; smartphone; active checking account (direct deposit only — no savings/prepaid); available in TaskRabbit metro areas.

steps: Register as a Tasker (18+, ID/SSN, background check) and enter bank info for direct deposit.
Set your rates and skills; get hired by clients for tasks (assembly, moving, cleaning, errands, etc.).
Complete the task and submit your invoice in the Tasker app (hours + agreed expenses).
Client is charged within 24 hours of your invoice.
Stripe processes the payout to your checking account — most arrive within 1–3 business days.
timing: Invoice after task → client charged within 24h → Stripe direct deposit, most arriving within 1–3 business days.
who_pays: The client who booked you pays through TaskRabbit's platform — you're an independent contractor.
who_qualifies: 18+; ID plus SSN; pass a background check; a smartphone; an active checking account (direct deposit only); in TaskRabbit metro areas.
work_available: An open marketplace — you set your own rates but compete with other Taskers on price, reviews, and responsiveness. First tasks come slowly: you need an approved profile and reviews before clients pick you.
what_gets_accepted: You invoice after the task and the client is charged within 24 hours of your invoice. All payments must go through the platform — off-platform payment is banned.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fee to join, but onboarding takes days (background check plus profile approval). Unpaid time: building your profile and winning your first clients with zero reviews.
when_cash_arrives: You invoice after the task, the client is charged within 24 hours, and Stripe direct deposit lands in your checking account in 1–3 business days.

repeatable.cadence: New tasks post daily — get hired, complete the task, invoice through the app, get paid via Stripe, and take the next one.
